name: co-tuong
description: Xe Pháo Mã — web game Cờ tướng & Cờ vua, monorepo TypeScript (React + NestJS)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cotuong/game-core && npm run build -w @cotuong/shared && npm run build -w @cotuong/ai

scripts.test: npm run test -w @cotuong/game-core && npm run test -w @cotuong/shared && npm run test -w @cotuong/ai && npm run test -w @cotuong/web
